name: compact-design
description: Compact Design JSON language, reusable core, and reference adapters.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @compact-design/core && npm run build -w @compact-design/html && npm run build -w @compact-design/figma-plugin
scripts.test: npm run test -w @compact-design/core && npm run test -w @compact-design/html && npm run test -w @compact-design/figma-plugin
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @compact-design/core && npm run typecheck -w @compact-design/html && npm run typecheck -w @compact-design/figma-plugin
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @compact-design/core && npm run lint -w @compact-design/html && npm run lint -w @compact-design/figma-plugin
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run lint && npm run build
